title: Manul's edition
description: This modpack aims to balance out between rpg, survival and sandbox aspects of the game, without straying too far from vanilla
body:
Heavily inspired by Raspberry Flavoured, Rebirth of the night, Better than Wolves and Terraria

This modpack aims to balance out between rpg, survival and sandbox aspects of the game, without alienating players who just want to build

# The modpack adds:
- Tooltips to many items explaining their uses
- Reworked progression tree
- More uses for diamonds
- Reworked equipment
- New exciting worldgen
> Custom attributes for each armor set to fullfill a certain role
> Several new armor sets like slime and steel
> New combat uses for shovels, pickaxes and hoes
- Reworked enchantment system based on materials instead of experience 
- Comfortable campfires! Campfires give you regeneration buff
- Sacks! They're like bundles but for unstackables


# Early game tutorial:
- Craft wooden tools
- Craft flint knife
- Fight skeletons or kill pigs with a knife to obtain bones
- Craft bone pickaxe
- Collect or make clay out of sand and bonemeal to make a furnace
- Craft a copper pickaxe
